summary: The repaired Playwright test file is valid TypeScript, uses Playwright APIs correctly, and includes awaited asynchronous assertions. The locator is specific and the test case ID is preserved in the test title. Minor selector specificity could be improved but is acceptable.

issues.description: The selector '[data-test="product-1"]' is specific but may be brittle if data-test attributes change. Consider using more stable selectors if available.
issues.recommendation: Review selector stability and consider adding fallback or more descriptive selectors.
